purpose: Compare complete compact() calls against the current main source, including fresh arena creation and output construction.
improvementRule: The upper 95% bootstrap confidence bound for the geometric mean candidate/baseline time across the four primary cases must be below 0.90 in both Node and Bun.
regressionRule: Report every case. A case is clear only if the upper 95% paired bootstrap bound for candidate/baseline time is at most 1.05. A lower bound above 1.05 is a regression; all other failures are unresolved. Report consistent smaller losses as well.
order: Alternate baseline/candidate then candidate/baseline for each case and process pair.
batchCalibration: Use both one-operation pilots. Select one shared iteration count to reach at least 8 ms for the faster pilot, capped at 256 operations and 64 MiB of output backing memory per batch.
processIsolation: One fresh child per case, arm and pair. Both arms load from one neutral path. Force garbage collection before each batch, outside its timer. Keep all observations.
checks: Check every output element before and after timing. Check output used bytes and backing memory against the other arm. Retain source hashes, bundle hashes, runtime versions, CPU, raw batches, launch errors, and all trial results.
scope: Warm repeated compaction on one x64 host. No startup, whole-process peak-memory, browser, ARM64, or application-wide claim follows from this local study. Run portability checks separately.
